Mendelian randomization analyses supported causal associations of high blood pressure with BG and HIP PVS, and of BG PVS with stroke. Conclusion In this first gene‐mapping study of PVS, one of the earliest MRI‐markers of cSVD, we describe 24 genome‐wide significant risk loci. Our findings provide completely novel insight into the biology of PVS across the adult lifespan and its contribution to cSVD pathophysiology, with potential for genetically informed prioritization of drug targets for prevention trials of cSVD, a major cause of stroke and dementia worldwide.</abstract>
